omission.chore: Help a bootstrapped startup scale its AWS use affordably.
omission.evidenceQuote: If you are a bootstrapped startup and need to scale on AWS but can't afford it, reply with your email and I will help you out
omission.reason: The fresh post explicitly states a need to scale on AWS and offers help. That is a concrete service task; lacking a narrower deliverable does not justify excluding it without five-criterion assessment.
